description: Raised whenever a password is changed for an application role.
Raised whenever any audit or audit specification is created, modified, or deleted. Any change to an audit is audited in that audit.
Raised whenever a backup or restore command is issued.

Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation completes executing. Audits the entire batch or stored procedure text (including the result). Applies to: SQL Server 2022 (16.x) and later.

Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation starts to execute. Audits the entire batch or stored procedure text. Applies to: SQL Server 2022 (16.x) and later.
Raised to report audit messages related to Service Broker transport security.
Raised when a database is created, altered, or dropped.
Raised when a contained database user signs out of a database.
Raised to report audit messages related to database mirroring transport security.
Raised whenever database objects (such as message types, assemblies, contracts) are accessed. Note: Can produce large audit records.
Raised when a CREATE, ALTER, or DROP statement is executed on database objects (such as schemas). Note: Can produce large quantities of audit records.
Raised when the owner of objects within database scope is changed.
Raised when a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for database objects (such as assemblies and schemas).
Raised when operations in a database (such as checkpoint or subscribe query notification) occur.
Raised when ALTER AUTHORIZATION is used to change the owner of a database.
Raised whenever a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for a statement permission by any principal (database-only events).
Raised when principals (such as users) are created, altered, or dropped from a database. Also covers certain deprecated role-related stored procedures.
Raised when an impersonation operation occurs in database scope (e.g., EXECUTE AS <principal>).
Raised whenever a login is added to or removed from a database role.
Raised whenever a principal issues any DBCC command.
Raised on external governance feature enablement/disablement, policy synchronization, and policy-based permissions enforcement.
Indicates that a principal tried to log on to a contained database and failed.
Indicates that a principal tried to log on to SQL Server and failed. Does not apply to Azure SQL Database.
Indicates a full-text event occurred.
Raised whenever a login password is changed (via ALTER LOGIN or sp_password).
Indicates that a principal has logged out of SQL Server.
Raised whenever an object permission has been used in the schema.
Raised when a CREATE, ALTER, or DROP operation is performed on a schema.
Raised when the permissions to change the owner of a schema object (table, procedure, function, etc.) are checked (via ALTER AUTHORIZATION).
Raised whenever a GRANT, DENY, or REVOKE is performed against a schema object.

Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation completes executing on sensitive data classified with SQL Data Discovery & Classification. Applies to: SQL Server 2022 (16.x) and later.
Raised for CREATE, ALTER, or DROP operations on server objects.
Raised when the owner is changed for objects in server scope.
Raised whenever a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for a server object permission.
Raised when Security Audit operations (altering settings, resources, external access, or authorization) are used, or a statement requiring VIEW SERVER STATE is run.
Raised when a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for permissions in the server scope.
Raised when server principals are created, altered, or dropped. Also covers certain login-related stored procedures and ALTER LOGIN.
Raised when an impersonation occurs within server scope (e.g., EXECUTE AS <login>).
Raised whenever a login is added to or removed from a fixed server role.
Raised when the SQL Server service state is modified.
Indicates that a principal successfully logged in to a contained database.
Indicates that a principal has successfully logged in to SQL Server.
Raised for all statements that check for the ALTER TRACE permission.
Raised for BEGIN/ROLLBACK/COMMIT TRANSACTION operations (explicit and implicit) and UNDO operations caused by transaction rollback.
Raised whenever the password of a contained database user is changed (via ALTER USER).
Monitors events raised by sp_audit_write (typically from triggers or stored procedures).
Raised for GENERATE LEDGER DIGEST and VERIFY LEDGER actions. Applies to: Azure SQL Database.
Raised whenever a password is changed for an application role.
Raised whenever any audit or audit specification is created, modified, or deleted.
Raised whenever a backup or restore command is issued.
Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation completes executing. Applies to: SQL Server 2019 (15.x) and later.
Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation starts to execute. Applies to: SQL Server 2019 (15.x) and later.
Raised when a database is created, altered, or dropped.
Raised when a contained database user signs out from a database.
Raised whenever database objects (such as certificates and asymmetric keys) are accessed.
Raised when a CREATE, ALTER, or DROP statement is executed on database objects (such as schemas).

Raised when a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for database objects (such as assemblies and schemas).
Raised when operations in a database (such as checkpoint or subscribe query notification) occur.
Raised when ALTER AUTHORIZATION is used to change the owner of a database.
Raised whenever a GRANT, REVOKE, or DENY is issued for a statement permission (database-only events).
Raised when principals (such as users) are created, altered, or dropped from a database. Also covers certain deprecated role-related stored procedures.
Raised when an impersonation occurs within database scope (e.g., EXECUTE AS <user>).
Raised whenever a login is added to or removed from a database role.
Raised whenever a principal issues any DBCC command.
Indicates that a principal tried to log on to a contained database and failed.
Raised whenever an object permission has been used in the schema.
Raised when a CREATE, ALTER, or DROP operation is performed on a schema.
Raised when the permissions to change the owner of a schema object are checked (via ALTER AUTHORIZATION).
Raised whenever a GRANT, DENY, or REVOKE is issued for a schema object.

Raised whenever any batch text, stored procedure, or transaction management operation completes executing on sensitive data classified with SQL Data Discovery & Classification. When configured at database scope, only captures batches that originate from and complete in the current database. Applies to: SQL Server 2022 (16.x) and later.
Indicates that a principal successfully logged in to a contained database.
Raised whenever the password of a contained database user is changed (via ALTER USER).
Monitors events raised by sp_audit_write.
Raised for ENABLE LEDGER, ALTER LEDGER, and ALTER LEDGER CONFIGURATION. Applies to: Azure SQL Database.
Raised whenever a SELECT is issued.
Raised whenever an UPDATE is issued.
Raised whenever an INSERT is issued.
Raised whenever a DELETE is issued.
Raised whenever an EXECUTE is issued.
Raised whenever a RECEIVE is issued.
Raised whenever a REFERENCES permission is checked.
Raised whenever one of the following commands is issued: CREATE/ALTER/DROP SERVER AUDIT, CREATE/ALTER/DROP SERVER AUDIT SPECIFICATION, or CREATE/ALTER/DROP DATABASE AUDIT SPECIFICATION.
